name: smoke
description: Whole-loop smoke test: install a ModForge plugin, boot the game, prove the engine loaded it, move the player, tear everything back down. Uses ModForgeNavmeshNoop.esp because it changes nothing observable — this test is about the harness, not the mod.

steps.label: clear any running session so the profile is writable
the engine actually loaded the plugin
we are in the tavern and it has people in it
steps.comment: Asserts cell_form_id, NOT cell. EditorID strings come from the winning record and any plugin that overrides it without an EDID subrecord erases them — ModForgeNavmeshNoop.esp does exactly that to this cell. FormIDs are engine identity and cannot be erased.

steps.message: 看一眼遊戲畫面：人應該站在戰友蜜酒館裡，NPC 正常站立、沒有 T-pose 或掉進地板。
